title: Tell a Friend about Your New Travel Plan
instructions: Write your own first draft, then submit it for feedback. Use different details from the models.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend who will meet you after a train journey. Explain the original arrangement, a change announced at the station, what you are doing now, and the new arrangement. Give one reason for your choice. Use at least six lesson words, a sentence about a usual habit, and two present continuous sentences with different meanings.

guidedOutput.title: 区分习惯、当前动作与后续安排
guidedOutput.text: Plan four parts: original journey; new information; current action and reason; new meeting arrangement. Check that your departure and arrival times agree. Useful frames: I usually ... / I am checking ... now. / We are meeting ... tomorrow.
